dedupe_keys.name: ukri digital research infrastructure net zero mapping survey

description: This survey records characteristics and environmental practices of UK digital research infrastructure. STFC researchers produced it for the 2021–2023 UKRI Net Zero Digital Research Infrastructure scoping project using a survey sent to facility managers in 2022. The README reports 44 records, and a separate metadata table maps 40 field codes to descriptions and original questions. Topics include computing capacity, storage, cooling, electricity supply, energy consumption, PUE, procurement and training. Geographic detail is UK region, not precise facility coordinates, and observations are survey responses, not monitored time series. CSV data and supporting documentation are publicly accessible free through Zenodo version 1.0 under CC BY 4.0; GitHub separately reports BSD 2-Clause. A limitation is the provider’s explicit warning that responses have not been verified. Energy labels also need checking because the dictionary states MWh/year while one original question asks kWh. Simulation uses include constructing facility archetypes and testing energy-efficiency assumptions. No related catalogue record was identified as this specific survey. The numerical responses and questionnaire PDF were not downloaded, and population representativeness was not established.
